text: Once upon a time, there lived a woman and her son, Jack.
Times were hard, and their only valuable possession was a cow.
One day, Jack's mother asked him to sell the cow at the market to get money for food.
As Jack walks toward town, a mysterious stranger wearing a big coat stops him and offers him five magic beans for the cow.
The man says that the beans will give Jack's family lots of riches.
Jack feels excited but also a little suspicious.

choices.text: Jack should ask himself whether the beans will really bring him anything useful.
Jack should trade the cow right away, thinking that the man might be telling the truth.
Walk away without asking anything because decisions are scary.

text: Jack thought about his options, but unfortunately, Jack traded the cow for the beans right away
because he felt that it was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
Jack goes home, and his mother is very angry that he got beans instead of money, and she throws the beans out the window.
The next morning, when Jack awakes, he sees that a huge beanstalk had grown outside of his window.
Jack rushes outside to go look at it.
He wants to know what is at the very top.

choices.text: How fast can I get to the top without anyone noticing?
My friends will think this is so cool if I get to the top!
What is my goal in climbing this? What could go wrong, and what could go right?

text: Jack falls!
It is important to be careful when trying something new.

text: Jack gets his mom, and together they decide to climb the beanstalk.
At the top is a huge castle.
His mom knocks on the door, and a kind-looking giantess opens the door.
She tells him that her husband, the Giant, is not always friendly.

Rush past her—she's probably just trying to scare him.
Listen carefully to the giantess's advice, and ask if there are safe ways he can look around.
